title: Herbaceous Dense Croatian Pork Roast
description: A tender pork roast infused with aromatic herbs, cooked sous‑vide for juiciness and finished with a buttery sear for a caramelized crust, ideal for a lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: Pat the pork dry and season all sides with salt, pepper, paprika and minced garlic.
Toss the herbs in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and coat the pork evenly.
Place the seasoned pork in a vacuum‑seal bag with the rosemary, thyme, oregano, and a splash of white wine. Seal and submerge the bag in the preheated water bath.
Cook sous‑vide for 3 hours, ensuring the bag stays fully submerged.
After 3 hours, remove the pork from the bag, pat dry with paper towels and let it rest 5 min.
Heat a cast‑iron skillet over high heat, add the remaining olive oil and butter. When the butter foams, add the pork. Sear each side 1–2 minutes until a golden brown crust forms.
Transfer the roast to a cutting board, tent loosely with foil and let rest 5 minutes.
Slice the roast into thick medallions, arrange on a platter and sprinkle with fresh lemon zest.
Serve immediately with a side of roasted vegetables or a simple salad for a complete meal.
